attribution.title: Attribution
attribution.liveData: Live aircraft data from adsb.fi — adsb.fi open-data API, reused under its published API terms.
attribution.dataAgeStale: Newer data may be available; this dataset was last updated on {{date}}.
attribution.kindNote: Some contours show permitted use: the noise the airport is allowed to cause within its government limits. Others show actual traffic: the noise measured or calculated for real flights in that year.
attribution.caveatAircraft: Positions are live ADS-B reports, refreshed every few seconds; a missing aircraft is not proof it is not flying.
attribution.caveatNoise: Contours show the annual average noise load, not live noise.
attribution.caveatAirports: Airport locations and details are reference data, updated occasionally.
attribution.caveatBasemap: The basemap shows the Netherlands in detail; abroad only country borders are shown. Borders are indicative, not a legal boundary.
attribution.caveatAircraftDatabase: Registration and type details come from a community database and may be incomplete or outdated. The database serves as a fallback: missing registration, type or operator is filled in from the snapshot (see the date above); live data always wins.
attribution.caveatUiIcons: The UI and map icons are Lucide (ISC; Feather-derived icons are also MIT). Licence details: LICENSES/lucide.txt.
attribution.caveatAnalytics: The country code attached to page views comes from MaxMind’s GeoLite2 database (embedded in the self-hosted GoatCounter). The IP address itself is never stored or logged.

title.map: VliegVuil.nl — live air traffic and noise contours

what.title: What is this site?
what.body: This site shows live aircraft movements over the Netherlands together with official noise contours around Dutch airports. It is an independent, non-commercial project. Coverage is currently limited to the Netherlands.

principle.title: Measurements, not causes
principle.body: This site shows measurements: what is in the air and where the noise contours are. No medical claims and no statements about causes unless an official study is cited. Noise contours are annual averages of the sound load — not live noise.

sources.title: Data sources
sources.body: All data comes from public sources with open licences. See the complete list of sources, dates and licences on the <1>sources page</1>.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: This site counts page views with a minimal, self-hosted counter on our own server: how many visits, when, and from which country — nothing else. Your IP address is processed in memory on our own server only (on the internal route to the counter) to derive that country and unique visits; it is never stored or logged, there are no cookies and no event tracking. Referring sites are counted only as hourly totals — our app never sends a referrer itself, so pages you navigate to within the site are never recorded as “referred by vliegvuil.nl” — and screen size, region and language are not collected. The aggregated statistics (hourly counts of pages, referrers, countries and browsers — no individual visitors) are kept without a set expiry for now; if a retention period is ever introduced, this page will say so. No access logs are kept, and your IP address is not forwarded to the aircraft data provider. The site asks your browser only for the app itself, the basemap, the aircraft data and the page-view count — all from vliegvuil.nl itself, no third party is contacted. The only thing stored locally is your unit preference (in your own browser, never sent).
